summary: This case reaches the same missing selected-handler binding in js/cmd.js:doextcmd() as the other two v49 cases. Upstream cmd.c:doextcmd() sets ge.ext_tlist and invokes the selected ef_funct pointer, so the selected doswapweapon() runs and its ECMD_* result is returned to rhack(). The JavaScript switch has no doswapweapon case and falls through to UnsupportedHeroCommandBoundaryError. The handler is already implemented in js/wield.js; its direct-key route already retains the return result. This bounded divergence fix adds only the corresponding doextcmd() binding and does not claim the whole function as ported.
